description: Korean probation minimum wage check (수습 최저임금) for 2026: 90% of the minimum wage (9,288 KRW/hour instead of 10,320) only for a contract of one year or more (or open-ended), within 3 months from the start of probation, and not in simple manual jobs (최저임금법 제5조②, 시행령 제3조). Returns the applicable minimum and the hourly and monthly shortfall (209 hours).

contractMonths.description: Contract length in months (0 = no fixed term)

monthsIntoProbation.description: Months since probation started (0 in the first month)

simpleLabor.description: Simple manual job (cleaning, security, delivery, kitchen help, shelving etc.)
